proof_body:
by
  have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s * |s|) (2 * |t|) t := by
    intro t
    have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s * s) (1 * t + t * 1) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' t).mul (hasDerivAt_id' t)
    have hneg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -(s * s)) (-(1 * t + t * 1)) t := hsq.neg
    rcases lt_trichotomy t 0 with ht | ht | ht
    · have h2 : (fun s : ℝ => s * |s|) =ᶠ[nhds t] fun s => -(s * s) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
        rw [abs_of_neg hs]; ring
      rw [abs_of_neg ht]
      exact (hneg.congr_of_eventuallyEq h2).congr_deriv (by ring)
    · subst ht
      have hl : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s : ℝ => s * |s|) (2 * |(0 : ℝ)|) (Set.Iic 0) 0 := by
        refine (hneg.hasDerivWithinAt.congr (fun s hs => ?_) (by simp)).congr_deriv (by simp)
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hs]; ring
      have hr : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s : ℝ => s * |s|) (2 * |(0 : ℝ)|) (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
        refine (hsq.hasDerivWithinAt.congr (fun s hs => ?_) (by simp)).congr_deriv (by simp)
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hs]
      have h := hl.union hr
      rw [Set.Iic_union_Ici, hasDerivWithinAt_univ] at h
      exact h
    · have h2 : (fun s : ℝ => s * |s|) =ᶠ[nhds t] fun s => s * s := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
        rw [abs_of_pos hs]
      rw [abs_of_pos ht]
      exact (hsq.congr_of_eventuallyEq h2).congr_deriv (by ring)
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun s => s * |s|, rfl, by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have := congrFun h 1
    simp at this
  · intro t
    simpa using hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℝ)
  · intro t
    have hs : Real.sqrt (abs (t * abs t)) = abs t := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_abs, Real.sqrt_mul_self (abs_nonneg t)]
    show HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s * |s|) (2 * Real.sqrt (abs (t * abs t))) t
    rw [hs]
    exact hd t
target_source: ∃ y₁ y₂ : ℝ → ℝ, y₁ 0 = 0 ∧ y₂ 0 = 0 ∧ y₁ ≠ y₂ ∧ (∀ t, HasDerivAt y₁ (2 * Real.sqrt |y₁ t|) t) ∧ (∀ t, HasDerivAt y₂ (2 * Real.sqrt |y₂ t|) t)
